hook.say: The ten highest mountains on Earth, ranked. Eight of them touch one small country!

outro.say: Could you name all ten? Comment below!

items.name: Annapurna
items.say: Number ten: Anna-poorna, the first giant ever climbed. 8091 meters.
items.cap: Number ten: Annapurna, the first giant ever climbed. 8,091 meters.

items.name: Nanga Parbat
items.say: Nine: Nung-ga Par-but, the western end of the Himalaya. 8126 meters.
items.cap: Nine: Nanga Parbat, the western end of the Himalaya. 8,126 meters.

items.name: Manaslu
items.say: Eight: Monnasloo, the mountain of the spirit. 8163 meters.
items.cap: Eight: Manaslu, the mountain of the spirit. 8,163 meters.

items.name: Dhaulagiri
items.say: Seven: Dowlageery, the white mountain. 8167 meters.
items.cap: Seven: Dhaulagiri, the white mountain. 8,167 meters.

items.name: Cho Oyu
items.say: Six: Cho Oh-you, the turquoise goddess. 8188 meters.
items.cap: Six: Cho Oyu, the turquoise goddess. 8,188 meters.

items.name: Makalu
items.say: Five: Mah-kah-loo, a perfect four-sided pyramid. 8485 meters.
items.cap: Five: Makalu, a perfect four-sided pyramid. 8,485 meters.

items.name: Lhotse
items.say: Four: Loat-say, Everest's next-door neighbor. 8516 meters.
items.cap: Four: Lhotse, Everest's next-door neighbor. 8,516 meters.

items.name: Kangchenjunga
items.say: Three: Kahnchenjoonga, the five treasures of snow. 8586 meters.
items.cap: Three: Kangchenjunga, the five treasures of snow. 8,586 meters.

items.name: K2
items.say: Two: Kay-two, the savage mountain. 8611 meters.
items.cap: Two: K2, the Savage Mountain. 8,611 meters.

items.name: Mount Everest
items.say: And number one: Mount Everest! 8849 meters, the roof of the world.
items.cap: And number one: Mount Everest! 8,849 meters, the roof of the world.
